# Fidelity coders on their own and the other's texts

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`fidelity-coders-on-own-and-other-texts` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F01 · [record](fidelity-coders-on-own-and-other-texts.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> On 240 English statements written and blind-coded by two model families, no negative combined author-coder interaction was detected for referents planted in the coder's own text (+0.02, CI [-0.05, +0.08]); one family's coder lists more excess in faithful texts (+0.16); LLM-coded, provisional.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- FC1's codebook v1.1, table pass with no key; FC1's Lean table (sha256 478c555f…) with one level of unfolding; plants made knowingly by each author in its own words as the ground truth for detection; a plant detected where an excess referent's span carries its new words.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the authoring model has no blind spot for its own controlled classical code: the texts are English under no name table, and the 經 case is untested.
- Which coder is miscalibrated on unplanted excess: the faithful texts carry no ground truth, and about half the unplanted count of the coder that lists more is numerals the codebook matches, a description made after the fact.
- Each coder's self effect apart: two families identify only their sum, and a knowing plant is not an unnoticed slip.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Design, decision rule and analysis code committed before any text was written; 480 of 480 codings (Claude: 6 Opus subagents; GPT: 12 gpt-6-astra runs through cx, blind, inline packets); cluster bootstrap over laws, B = 10,000; no human audit.
